notes.title: Collector's Edition - Soundtrack Remastered & Extended
notes.content:
[h1]There are fewer games out there that celebrate Halloween and the Fall Season as much as Moonrise Fall.[/h1] 
To help celebrate that I'm introducing the [b]Moonrise Fall Collector's Edition[/b]. Which includes the full game as well as the [b]soundtrack[/b]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34660493/ba31d3db7ab0ec6ce1155c3bbf1bec1ec2a37bec.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=YC7d3Gg4Sc0;full][/previewyoutube]

The hauntingly captivating soundtrack for Moonrise Fall has been [b]Remastered[/b] and [b]Extended[/b]. Now includes songs unused in the game.

Song-list:
01 - Shatter
02 - Lunar Light
03 - Mines and Fields
04 - Into the Dark
05 - Skipping Stones
06 - Mystery Machine
07 - Wild Ride
08 - Start from the End
09 - Homecoming
10 - Shutter

In the future I plan to release an [b]Art Book DLC[/b] including [b]concept art[/b] and [b]behind-the-scenes[/b] info. [u]The collector's edition will automatically include that future DLC.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34660493/7fcedff91ea5becc07ed38263e3530bde9431ff7.png[/img]

Thanks & Enjoy the game,
Chris / Made From Strings
